speech:
I endorse the exact draft with SHA-256 67507be5cfccaaecfec8270517710243e83338bf4435a20bce2ba96c47459cf8 in my analytical capacity. My endorsement covers the bounded audit and monitoring specification; it supplies no operational release authority.

Ops, your actual response resolves my collection-burden question as an assignment: the supplied senior dispatcher records exactly two rows, with up to 20 minutes for completion beyond the 30-minute worker sequences. You have absorbed preparation into the workflow scope and have not claimed attendance, acknowledgement or assessor bookings. I accept that distinction between assigned capacity and demonstrated execution.

The retained audit matches my 2-unit commitment: use the existing export, document the changed denominators, show supported shift-level counts and annotation coverage, and explicitly mark unavailable comparisons. Historical missing annotations remain irrecoverable; a shift-specific increase is not established. The 9 units are scoped project commitments, with one unit unspent, rather than evidence that all activities occurred.

I agree with no release on the current evidence. The unresolved attendees, supervisor acknowledgement and assessor scheduling remain blockers, and the draft permits audit and preparation only. Following the scientist's actual advice, the proposed clinic records cannot establish independent competence, delayed retention or workforce-wide transfer. Improvement this week remains unobserved. I request no change to these exact bytes.
